structures.label: Latissimus dorsi
structures.description: Broad back muscle that starts on the lower spine and pelvis via the thoracolumbar fascia.
structures.function: Pulls the arm down and back; also stiffens the lower back.

structures.label: Thoracolumbar fascia
structures.description: Diamond-shaped sheet of connective tissue over the lower back.
structures.function: Links the lats, glutes and core into one stabilising "corset".

structures.label: Gluteus medius
structures.description: Fan-shaped muscle on the side of the pelvis.
structures.function: Keeps the pelvis level; weakness often contributes to back pain.

structures.label: Erector spinae (lumbar)
structures.description: Thick muscle columns on both sides of the lumbar spine.
structures.function: Extend the spine; work hard in deadlifts and lifting.

structures.label: Multifidus
structures.description: Deepest back muscle, packed against the lumbar vertebrae.
structures.function: Stabilises each lumbar segment; often weak after back pain.

structures.label: Quadratus lumborum
structures.description: Square muscle from the pelvis to the lowest rib and lumbar vertebrae.
structures.function: Bends the trunk sideways and hitches the hip; a common source of back pain.

structures.label: Psoas major
structures.description: Long muscle from the lumbar vertebrae to the femur.
structures.function: Flexes the hip and stabilises the lumbar spine.

structures.label: Lumbar discs
structures.description: Thick cartilage cushions between the lumbar vertebrae.
structures.function: Absorb load; L4-L5 and L5-S1 are where most herniations occur.

structures.label: Iliolumbar ligament
structures.description: Ligament from L5 to the iliac crest.
structures.function: Anchors the lowest vertebra to the pelvis.

structures.label: Sacroiliac ligaments
structures.description: Strong ligaments around the joints between sacrum and pelvis.
structures.function: Make the sacroiliac joint very stable with only a few degrees of motion.

structures.label: Lumbar vertebrae L1–L5
structures.description: Five large vertebrae of the lower back.
structures.function: Carry most of the upper body weight and allow bending.

structures.label: Sacrum
structures.description: Triangular bone at the base of the spine.
structures.function: Transfers load from the spine to the pelvis.

structures.label: Hip bones
structures.description: The two pelvic bones joined to the sacrum.
structures.function: Attachment for the back, core and gluteal muscles.
